title: Verify the template list columns and the edit/delete actions
custom_preconds: 1. The location has at least 1 template.
custom_steps:
1. Open Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts.
2. Read the table column headers and the row buttons.
custom_expected:
1. The columns, left to right, are: Name, Type, Calculation Type, Amount, Max Amount, Taxable, Auto-Apply To Work Orders.
2. Each row has an edit (pencil) button and a delete (red trash) button.
All columns are plain text with no coloured badges (Type and Auto-Apply To Work Orders are plain text), and every column is left-aligned and evenly distributed.
